scripts.deploy:local: npm exec --workspace contracts -- hardhat run scripts/deploy-local.js --network localhost
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:wallet && npm run test:e2e:reserve
scripts.test:e2e:wallet: playwright test e2e/api-timeouts.spec.ts e2e/service-readiness.spec.ts e2e/wallet-provider.spec.ts e2e/wallet.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:setup: node -e "if(Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])<24){console.error('Node.js 24 or newer is required.');process.exit(1)}" && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && playwright install chromium
